headline: Mooring Breach Repelled as Stonecradle and Linn of Mercy Flare
war_summary: Warden forces have swiftly repelled the Colonial breach across Mooring County, retaking Wiccwalk and restoring a complete twelve-strongpoint monopoly amidst more than twenty-two hundred casualties in the past two hours. The fiercest fighting has shifted southward and westward into Stonecradle, which exploded into action with two base upheavals around World's End and over forty-three hundred casualties in two hours, even as rates began to cool in the latest hour. Adjacent Linn of Mercy has likewise ignited, claiming twenty-one hundred dead and producing two base turnovers centered on Outwich Ranch and Lathair. In contrast, the furious churn in Fisherman's Row has frozen with Colonials now holding all nine island bases without an exchange in two hours, while Weathered Expanse similarly paused its rapid string of captures despite absorbing another fifty-seven hundred casualties. On the eastern perimeter, Stlican Shelf yielded a second strategic strongpoint to Colonial banners before action eased, and Dead Lands marked an abrupt escalation in Warden losses against unyielding Colonial lines.
